description: Corrected gold labels for 11 SciFact dev-set claim-document pairs + 1 per-document error
source_paper: Gold Label Errors in the SciFact Benchmark: An LLM-Assisted Annotation Audit

corrections.justification: Evidence states incidence 'did not change over time'; claim says 'decreased by 10%'
Abstract sentence [6] concludes 'the large majority of lincRNAs do not function through encoded proteins', agreeing with claim
Rationale states 'enhancing cSMAC formation reduced stimulatory capacity', opposite of claim
Abstract sentence [3] states 'does not rely on cis-acting sequences', contradicting claim
Claim asks about bleeding events; evidence reports CV mortality, MI, stroke, CHF—bleeding never mentioned
Claim asks about preterm birth; evidence reports gestational diabetes, pre-eclampsia, SGA—preterm birth absent
PFS non-significant (p=0.07); QoL comparison is between two fluoropyrimidines, not single-agent vs combination
Paper reports on mouse Tmem27; claim specifies 'human beta cells'
Paper studies V. cholerae and A. baylyi; claim attributes to E. coli
Rationale cites rifampicin (1960s drug); claim says 'new drugs'. Moxifloxacin data supports claim direction but 'often' is unsupported
Abstract sentences [1] and [8] establish CHEK2 role in breast cancer and report OR 2.26 for 1100delC mutation
Third evidence document discusses cervical cancer mortality; claim is about incidence
